chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman who releases her husband from her dowry while she is ill, and he said, 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Can a wife release her husband from her dowry while she is ill?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) rules that a woman cannot validly release her husband from her dowry (*mahr*) while in her deathbed illness (*marad al-mawt*). This ruling highlights the principle that gifts or releases made during the final illness are treated similarly to bequests (*wasiyyah*) and are subject to specific validity conditions to prevent preferential treatment of heirs or debtors over other creditors.
